RTRIM(string, [characters_to_trim])
Returns the input string, with all trailing characters in the set of
characters_to_trim removed.
Parameters
string: The string to process.
characters_to_trim: Optional. The set of characters to trim. Defaults to a
space.
Returns
The right-trimmed string.
Example
TRIM(" Lancelot ", " ") == " Lancelot"
